purpose: Independent security classification of Trust Gate benchmark fixtures without using scanner output as ground truth.

classifications.vulnerable: The fixture contains a security weakness with a supported source, sink, configuration, or dependency-scope rationale.
classifications.patched: The fixture is the distinct secure equivalent of a paired vulnerable case and removes or safely constrains that weakness.
classifications.safe_lookalike: The fixture resembles a scanner signal but lacks the corresponding security weakness.

review_requirements: Review the fixture content rather than scanner output.
Record a decision for every development-public case.
Cite at least one hash-bound file and line range for every decision.
Disclose conflicts and attest that the review was completed independently.
Do not inspect the other review before submitting an integrity-bound record.

confidence.certain: Direct evidence establishes the classification with no material ambiguity.
confidence.probable: Evidence supports the classification but one material assumption remains.
confidence.uncertain: Available evidence permits more than one reasonable classification.

partition_policy.development_public: May be used for rule development and tuning.
partition_policy.evaluation_public_blind: Fixture content is public but committed labels are withheld from evaluators and rule tuning.
partition_policy.evaluation_private: Only fixture and label commitments are public; content and labels remain with the benchmark custodian.

prohibited_practices: Treating scanner agreement as ground truth.
Using public-blind or private evaluation data for rule tuning.
Changing a decision after seeing evaluation results without a new review revision.
Publishing metrics without corpus, partition, review, adjudication, scanner, and configuration versions.
